name: multi-social-downloader
description: Multi Social Media Downloader (Web & Electron Desktop App)

scripts.dev:electron: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ELECTRON" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && npm --prefix electron run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend && npm run build:electron
